content:
BUILT CoLAB will host and co-supervise 3 PhD students with scholarships awarded by the FCT to carry out their studies in a non-academic environment: Elis Ribeiro, Jaime Cunha and Ahmed Ashour. The applications were developed in close collaboration between the students and their supervisors, based on the core skills of the BUILT CoLAB team.

Work plans to be developed:

“Redução do impacte ambiental da impressão 3D na construção com a integração de resíduos na argamassa”, by the student Elis Ribeiro.

Instituição que Confere o Grau: Universidade do Porto – Faculdade de Engenharia

Co-orientação: Bárbara Rangel (FEUP), Lino Maia (FEUP) e Vanessa Tavares (BUILT CoLAB)

“Roadmap for Integrated Project Design performed by additive manufacturing”, by the student Jaime Cunha.

Instituição que confere o grau: Universidade do Porto – Faculdade de Engenharia

Co-orientação: Bárbara Rangel (FEUP), Rodrigo Vilas-Boas (OODA Arquitetura Lda); Luís Sanhudo (BUILT CoLAB)

“Risk Analysis of Supply Chain Management of the Construction Industry in Critical Zones: A Case Study of Palestine”, by the student Ahmed Ashour

Instituição que confere o grau: Instituto Superior Técnico

Co-orientação: Carlos da Silva Cruz (IST); Luís Sanhudo (BUILT CoLAB)

FCT doctoral scholarships are designed to fund research activities leading to a doctoral degree, carried out in close co-operation with non-academic organisations. BUILT CoLAB, as a Collaborative Laboratory, follows its mission by being involved with these students, maintaining their close connection to academia while promoting their connection to the business environment.
